title: Pikmin 3 Deluxe
description: Pikmin 3 Deluxe follows three explorers from Koppai as they search planet PNF-404 for food that can save their homeworld. The Deluxe release adds full story co-op, new prologue and epilogue side stories featuring Olimar and Louie, difficulty options, quality-of-life changes, a bestiary-style Piklopedia, and the DLC content from the Wii U original.

contents.label: Nintendo Switch Online features where supported

gameplayPillars.title: Three-captain strategy
gameplayPillars.description: Switch between Alph, Brittany, and Charlie to divide tasks and manage the map efficiently.

gameplayPillars.title: Pikmin type specialization
gameplayPillars.description: Use Red, Yellow, Blue, Rock, and Winged Pikmin according to hazards, enemy armor, terrain, and puzzle design.

gameplayPillars.title: Food-gathering campaign
gameplayPillars.description: The core story is driven by collecting fruit and seeds to save the explorers’ home planet from famine.

gameplayPillars.title: Full story co-op
gameplayPillars.description: Deluxe adds cooperative story play so a second player can help divide exploration and battle duties.

gameplayPillars.title: Side stories and challenge modes
gameplayPillars.description: Olimar and Louie side missions, Mission Mode, Bingo Battle, and extra challenges extend replay value.

worldSummary: PNF-404 is presented at miniature scale, turning gardens, caves, rivers, debris, and wildlife into strategic environments where every route and object matters.

storyChapters.title: Crash on PNF-404
storyChapters.body: Three Koppai explorers are separated after a failed landing on the planet.

storyChapters.title: Discover Pikmin allies
storyChapters.body: The crew learns to command several Pikmin types with unique strengths.

storyChapters.title: Gather fruit to save Koppai
storyChapters.body: Each expedition day centers on efficient exploration and returning food to the ship.

storyChapters.title: Track Olimar’s clues
storyChapters.body: The search for the Cosmic-drive Key intersects with clues left behind by Olimar and Louie.

storyChapters.title: Escape with a solution
storyChapters.body: The campaign builds toward recovery of the crew, the key, and enough food data to help Koppai.

features: Story campaign playable in local co-op
New Olimar and Louie side stories
Multiple difficulty options and quality-of-life improvements
Mission Mode and Bingo Battle add replay value

faq.a: It adds story co-op, new side stories, difficulty settings, quality-of-life improvements, and all DLC from the Wii U version.

faq.q: Can two players play the story?
faq.a: Yes. The Deluxe version supports local co-op in Story Mode.
Yes, as backward-compatible Nintendo Switch software.

faq.q: Is Nintendo Switch Online required for the main story?
faq.a: No. The main story and local co-op do not require Nintendo Switch Online.

faq.q: How is it different from Pikmin 4?
faq.a: Pikmin 3 Deluxe focuses on three captains and food collection, while Pikmin 4 introduces a different rescue-corp structure and Oatchi.

verdictPros: Excellent balance of strategy and exploration
Story co-op is a major improvement
Deluxe content meaningfully expands the original
verdictCons: Main campaign is shorter than Pikmin 4
Bingo Battle is local rather than a major online mode
Some multitasking systems take time to learn
Difficulty can become light for series veterans
Older Wii U design roots are still visible
